body: Can you provide a minimal reproduction example?
The regression is occured somewhere between `astroid==2.4.0` and `astroid==2.3.3`

issue.title: Fix a crash caused by not guarding against `InferenceError` when calling `infer_call_result`

repository.name: pylint
repository.description: It's not just a linter that annoys you!

issue.body:
## Steps

- [ ] Add yourself to CONTRIBUTORS if you are a new contributor.

- [ ] If it's a new feature or an important bug fix, add a What's New entry in `doc/whatsnew/<current release.rst>`.
- [ ] Write a good description on what the PR does.

## Description

`infer_call_result` can raise `InferenceError` and should be handler in all call sites. This was not happening with this particular check.
